story.iWant: to configure company details, logo, address, tax code, and fiscal year
story.soThat: branding appears correctly and the platform has legal entity details for all outputs
story.tasks: - Backend: Company entity/validation (AC: #1, #3, #4) - Add/verify unique constraints for company.code and company.tax_code (DB/Flyway) - DTOs + validation: @NotBlank fields, VN address pattern, tax code checksum - Service methods to update settings with audit logging (old → new) - File storage integration for logo (Supabase Storage) with type/size validation - Backend: API endpoints (AC: #1, #2, #4) - GET /api/v1/admin/company/settings - PUT /api/v1/admin/company/settings (multipart for logo) - RBAC: admin, chief_accountant only - Audit: log setting changes with actor and timestamp - Frontend: Company Settings page (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Form fields: name, tax code, address, fiscal year start, contact info, logo upload - Client-side validation and inline error messaging (VN locale) - Live preview of logo and footer before save - Responsive layout, aligns with ProtectedLayout - Reporting integration (AC: #5) - Ensure report exports include company logo and legal info in footer - Add config-driven footer rendering path - Testing (maps to ACs) - Backend unit + integration tests for validation, RBAC, audit logging - Frontend tests for form validation and preview behavior - Export tests verify footer content appears in generated files

doc.title: Epic 1 – Story 1.6: Company Settings
doc.snippet: Company Settings requires logo upload, validated fields (name, address, tax code, fiscal year start), preview before save, strict validation, audit logging for all changes, and inclusion of logo/legal info in report footers.

doc.title: PRD – Functional Requirements
doc.snippet: An Admin or Chief Accountant configures company information (name, tax code, address, logo, fiscal year start date) with validation according to Vietnamese standards.

doc.title: PRD – Functional Requirements
doc.snippet: The system records an append-only audit log for critical actions; changes to company settings must be logged with who/when and old/new values.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Security stack uses JWT, Spring Security, and RBAC; company context and row-level scoping must apply to Company Settings reads/updates.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Backend structure: controller/admin, service/impl, entity, dto; Frontend feature-first under features/company with page CompanySettings.tsx and related services.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Admin settings include company info and fiscal year configuration; branding guidelines ensure logo scaling and consistent headers/footers.

artifact.reason: Existing company endpoints; pattern/reference for adding settings endpoints under admin scope.
Service layer contract; extend with get/update settings methods.
Validation and uniqueness checks for code/tax_code; reuse approach for settings update and auditing.
Company scoping enforced; all settings operations must respect current company context.
Audit logging service; required to log old/new values for settings changes.

story-context.constraints: - Enforce company scoping via CompanyContext for all reads/updates. - RBAC: only admin and chief_accountant may access settings endpoints. - Validate required fields; Vietnamese address format and 10-digit tax code. - Unique constraints for company code and tax_code; reject duplicates with clear errors. - Append-only audit trail: log old/new values, actor, timestamp for every change. - Logo upload: PNG/JPEG, ≤256KB; stored via external storage with secure URLs.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 with Testcontainers for integration; audit and RBAC enforced in tests. Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom; client-side validation and preview behavior verified.
tests.ideas: - AC1: Validate required fields, unique tax_code; FE inline errors appear. - AC2: Logo preview scales correctly for header/report targets. - AC3: Vietnamese address pattern; duplicate code/tax_code rejected with clear message. - AC4: AuditService records old/new values with actor/timestamp on settings update. - AC5: Report exports include company logo and legal footer lines.
